name: OpiumActClassification
title: Opiumwet classification
description: Opiumwet classification of the prescribed product, as a G-Standaard bijzonder kenmerk.
purpose: Carried as a CodeableConcept rather than a boolean because codes 2 ('in volle omvang') and 65 ('afhandeling als UR') have materially different consequences for a pharmacist, and a boolean flattens that away.

element.definition: Opiumwet classification of the prescribed product, as a G-Standaard bijzonder kenmerk.

element.short: The Opiumwet code; absent when the product does not fall under the Opiumwet
element.comment: Prescriptor reports only a yes/no today, which corresponds to rubriek 72 nr 2, so only code 2 is emitted. Codes 65 and 107 become available without a breaking change if the upstream is enriched.
